description: Satin ceramic healthcare mission icons in jade and ivory, optimized to 256px PNG with the generated transparency preserved.

Asset type: a single premium healthcare app mission icon for Asinu, clearly recognizable at 64 pixels.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha background, one isolated object only.
Style: refined satin ceramic miniature, rounded but precise product geometry, understated 3D depth, crisp clean silhouette. Not a flat emoji, not a scene or banner.
Consistent set design: jade green #0F756B, pale mint #68C9B8, warm ivory #F5F1E8, restrained aqua #7ECFDF. Soft upper-left studio light, front three-quarter view with a modest 15 degree elevation. Center subject, similar optical weight to other icons in the set, entire object visible, occupies about 78% of a square canvas with comfortable clear margin.
